findings.comment: Gross Floor Area (GFA) of 83,986 sf divided by site area of 94,192 sf yields Floor Area Ratio (FAR) of 0.89:1, which exceeds the MF-2 maximum of 0.5:1. No approved variance, development bonus, or density bonus authorization is documented on the site plan or supplementary documents. The applicant must either obtain an approved FAR variance from the appropriate authority, claim and document an eligible development bonus, or reduce the gross floor area to achieve an FAR of 0.5:1 or less.
